business_summary: Good Fellow Healthcare Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides general hospital services in the People's Republic of China. The company's general hospital services include medical and surgical wards, and medical checkup and examination. It also offers medical investment and hospital management services. The company was formerly known as Hua Xia Healthcare Holdings Limited and changed its name to Good Fellow Healthcare Holdings Limited in February 2019. Good Fellow Healthcare Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong. The company operates as a subsidiary of Solar Star Global Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Good Fellow Healthcare Holdings Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 종합 병원 서비스를 제공합니다. 회사의 종합 병원 서비스에는 내과 및 수술 병동, 건강 검진 및 검사가 포함됩니다. 또한 의료 투자 및 병원 관리 서비스도 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Hua Xia Healthcare Holdings Limited로 알려졌으며 2019년 2월에 Good Fellow Healthcare Holdings Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Good Fellow Healthcare Holdings Limited는 2001년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 센트럴에 본사를 두고 있습니다. 이 회사는 Solar Star Global Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
